text: As I enter this modern, glass-encased room, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The environment is clean, open, and charged with possibility. Moving further, I am confronted by vibrant colors and the bold letters "R+D"—symbols of improvement, innovation, and inquiry. I feel intellectually engaged, compelled to ponder the endless processes of research and development that shape our world. There is a hum of progress here, and being present amidst these displays, I sense both humanity's restless drive and our yearning to understand and transform.
